title: Taking Responsibility (Father-Focused)
description: This course supports fathers to take responsibility for behaviour that affects partners and children, and to understand how responsibility supports child safety.
learningOutcomes: Understand responsibility in the context of fatherhood.
Recognise avoidance patterns that harm children.
Learn how responsibility supports safe parenting.

modules.title: Fatherhood and Responsibility
modules.content: Explores responsibility in parenting and relationships.

modules.title: Avoidance and Harm
modules.content: Shows how blame and excuses affect family safety.

modules.title: Practising Accountability
modules.content: Provides tools for consistent, responsible behaviour.
